text:
kevin: Heads-up — last 48h we've seen a spike in GPU Xid/ECC events in eu-west-1 and it's taking >2h to triage because logs are scattered. Can we standardize a minimal "fast-path" log bundle we can pull automatically when a node shows Xid/ECC?

maria: +1. Current triage steps: `journalctl -k`, `dmesg`, `nvidia-smi -q`, driver logs under /var/log/nvidia*, and kubelet logs. Too many manual steps.

sre-jen: Suggestion: when node exporter detects `nvidia` errors or node condition GPU_FAIL we archive a small bundle to s3 and attach to the incident. Bundle should be tiny (<5MB) and collected within 5m.

ops-li: What exact files/commands do we want in the bundle? Also need to ensure no sensitive customer data gets included.

kevin: Minimal proposal (fast-path):
- `dmesg --ctime | tail -n 500 | grep -i -E "xid|ecc|gpu|nvrm"`
- `journalctl -k -n 500 --no-pager | grep -i -E "Xid|Ecc|GPU|nvrm"`
- `nvidia-smi -q -d ERRORS,GRAPHICS,DIAGNOSTIC -x` (XML is parseable)
- `/var/log/nvidia-installer.log` and `/var/log/nvidia-suspend.log` if present
- `kubectl describe node <node>` and list of `pods --field-selector spec.nodeName=<node> -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name} {end}'`
- basic system info: `/etc/os-release`, `uname -a`, `lspci -vvv | grep -i nvidia -A4`

maria: Also include NVML error counters: `python - <<'PY'
import pynvml, json
pynvml.nvmlInit()
h = pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex(0)
print(json.dumps({
  'ecc': pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetMemoryErrorCounter(h, pynvml.NVML_MEMORY_ERROR_TYPE_CORRECTED, pynvml.NVML_VOLATILE_ECC),
  'retired': pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetRetiredPages(h)
}))
PY`
(we can run with container runtime to avoid host python deps)

sre-jen: Good. We should make the collector idempotent and rate-limited (no more than 1 archive per node per 30m) to avoid S3 spam. Also sign the bundle metadata with node-id, driver version, and timestamp.

ops-li: For privacy, we should scrub pod logs and only include pod metadata+names. No stdout/stderr.

kevin: Parsing side: we need a rule set that classifies bundles into: ECC_CORRECTABLE, ECC_UNCORRECTABLE, XID_SPECIFIC (with code), DRIVER_CRASH, FLAKY_CARD. Heuristics: look for `Xid 31` vs `Xid 61` patterns, NVML retired pages >0 => FLAKY_CARD/RETIRE.

maria: We can add lightweight fingerprint: last 20 lines of `dmesg` hashed + nvidia-smi error xml hashed to detect repeated recurring failures. Helps to auto-tag nodes for replacement.

gpu-monitor-bot: Automated alert: Detected Xid in node gpu-eu-12 at 2025-11-02T15:12:08Z, collecting fast-path bundle (job id: fp-20251102-2345).

ops-li: For K8s workflow, collector should annotate node with `gpu.fastpath.s3://bucket/path` and post a short incident comment with link. That lets on-call click & triage.

kevin: Ops checklist for triage once bundle is available:
1) Check NVML retired pages >0 -> schedule node drain+replace.
2) If Xid code maps to driver bug -> escalate to infra-ml and attach full driver/patch info.
3) If logs show thermal/power spikes -> schedule hardware swap and check rack PDUs.
4) If repeated fingerprint matches >3 times -> mark pool as flaky and reduce capacity.

maria: Implementation approach: small daemonset (Go) that subscribes to node-exporter metrics and kube events, runs collectors in an ephemeral privileged container, uploads gzipped bundle, sends slack msg to #eng-infra via webhook.

sre-jen: Agree. Add RBAC for read-only node info and a single service account with constrained S3 permissions (PutObject to specific prefix). Also add a feature flag per-cluster so we can rollout to eu-west first.

kevin: Timeline: prototype this week, test on staging, rollout to eu-west canary next Wed, global after validation. Who owns the prototype?

maria: I'll spin up the PoC background job and report results by EOD Friday.

ops-li: I'll draft the node annotation and S3 policy.

kevin: Thanks. If the PoC shows noisy duplicates, we'll tighten the rate-limits and fingerprint window.

sre-jen: One more: capture `nvidia-smi topo -m` to detect if PCIe bus resets correlate with errors.

maria: added. I'll ping here with a sample bundle link when PoC finishes. :rocket:
